description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Strategy_RemoveForeignElements', which implements a strategy for removing unrecognized or foreign HTML tags and comments from a list of tokens during HTML purification. It includes logic for handling tag transformations, attribute validation, comment processing, and token filtering based on configuration options.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_RemoveForeignElements
classes.description: A strategy class for removing or transforming foreign or unrecognized HTML elements and comments during HTML purification.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the removal or transformation of unrecognized or foreign HTML tokens based on the provided configuration, returning a filtered list of tokens.
